description: PopulationStudy Experiment 3: same leave-patient split as Experiment 2, but train episodically (leave-one-train-patient-out each cycle) so the optimizer sees a zero-shot patient during training.
inner_zero_shot_note: P1 is the default inner query (zero-out) patient among the train set. Rotation over P1/P3/P4/P5 is the alternative (see README). P7/P9 never enter train or val.
val_split_method: per train patient: Random(val_split_seed + patient_index).shuffle(100 pairs); take first 10% as val. Val is train-patients only.
